title: creative industry research - week 2
introduction:
1.Crip technoscience：Crip technoscience is a way of thinking about technology and knowledge from disabled people’s experiences. It sees disabled people as “experts and designers of everyday life” and values the knowledge that comes from adapting, changing, or reworking technologies. （Hamraie, A. and Fritsch, K. (2019). “Crip Technoscience Manifesto.” *Catalyst: Feminism, Theory, Technoscience*, 5(1). ）\
2.Criptech art：Criptech art refers to art made by disabled artists who use digital and scientific technologies both as creative tools and as a way to explore disability and access.（Chang, V. and Felt, L.D. (2024). “Criptech and the Art of Access: Introduction to Special Issue.” *Leonardo*, 57(2), pp. 129–131. ）\
3.Participatory description：Participatory description is a collaborative way of creating visual or audio descriptions. Instead of one person deciding how something should be described, different people can take part in the description process. The article presents it as a collective access project for blind and low-vision users. （Kleege, G. and Wallin, S. (2015). “Audio Description as a Pedagogical Tool.” *Disability Studies Quarterly*, 35(2).）
